baseline_models.focus_anchor: هَٰذِهِ ... تُوعَدُونَ joins deictic identification to a passive promise or threat.
baseline_models.mechanism: The demonstrative turns a formerly verbal menace into a present referent, while كُنتُمْ bridges prior repeated address to the moment of identification.

activation_trace.role: The threat-specific warning supplies the prior verbal menace that هَٰذِهِ now identifies as present.
Occurrence and presence through time give كُنتُمْ its bridge from earlier address to the current encounter.

changed_reading.after: The threatened reality is pointed out as the object now before its recipients.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The relative clause ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ identifies جَهَنَّم through the promise attached to it.
baseline_models.mechanism: Reading the promise through موعد gives the clause a rendezvous structure: هَٰذِهِ marks arrival at a previously fixed time or place.

activation_trace.role: A promise fixed by time or place makes Jahannam the appointed encounter to which هَٰذِهِ points.

changed_reading.before: Jahannam is a future punishment mentioned earlier.
changed_reading.after: Jahannam is the appointed encounter whose time and place have become deictically accessible.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: تُوعَدُونَ carries the packet's non-dominant ع د د mapping alongside the direct و ع د inventory.
baseline_models.mechanism: The split inventory permits the promised outcome to be carried as something readied through a counted interval, so the utterance can sound like the end of both preparation and waiting.

activation_trace.role: Preparation of equipment or provision supplies the exploratory image of an outcome made ready in advance.
A counted waiting period supplies the exploratory countdown whose expiry is announced by هَٰذِهِ.

changed_reading.after: A prepared outcome is unveiled when its counted waiting interval has run out.

context_deltas.mechanism: The early warning is meant to awaken caution, and the following saying becomes fixed in correspondence with reality; the focus threat is therefore speech that has crossed from notification into realization.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch supplies the threat whose transition from warning to reality is being traced.
Warning that frightens and awakens caution establishes the intended preventive force of the earlier address.
Fixity matching reality converts the following saying from mere utterance into an obtaining state.
Spoken saying supplies the verbal object whose realization culminates in the focus identification.

structural_cues: 36:6 repeats the act of warning before 36:7 states that the saying has taken effect.
The focus replaces warning language with the direct presentation هَٰذِهِ جَهَنَّمُ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies caution-awakening warning and a saying fixed as reality; I supply the process arrow from warning to realized threat. A live alternative is that the two early clauses classify hearers rather than narrate a procedural sequence.

changed_reading.before: This is the punishment about which warning was given.
changed_reading.after: This is the warning-word after it has become the reality it announced.

context_deltas.mechanism: An exhaustive written count of prior acts and traces is later joined to act-matched recompense, activating the focus's split preparation branch: the destination reads as a readied result of an audit.

activation_trace.role: Preparation in advance supplies the exploratory sense that the promised destination has been made ready.
Writing as an establishment that entails judgment turns past acts and traces into an operative record.
Exact enumeration makes the record exhaustive and supplies the counted side of the mechanism.
Matching an act with its recompense converts the record into an outcome rather than inert documentation.
Intentional action supplies the conduct to which the resulting destination is matched.

structural_cues: 36:12 records what was sent ahead and the traces left behind, then counts everything.
36:54 restricts recompense to what the recipients had been doing immediately before the two cohorts are described.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exhaustive record and act-matched recompense; I infer that this record functionally prepares the presented destination. The live alternative is that the ledger only demonstrates justice and does not generate or prepare the punishment.

changed_reading.before: A threatened destination appears at judgment.
changed_reading.after: The destination appears as a prepared, enumerated consequence of a fully retained record.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured ordering, respite until an allotted time, the explicit question about the promise, and universal presence together give موعد both temporal and spatial force.

activation_trace.role: The fixed time-or-place branch anchors the focus as an appointment now reached.
Ordering by measure and deliberation supplies a staged temporal pattern rather than an indefinite delay.
A thing's due time gives the preceding respite a boundary.
The explicit موعد-like promise is challenged precisely as to when its fixed point will arrive.
Presence, witnessing, and nearness supply arrival at the appointed arena.

structural_cues: 36:39 presents measured stages, 36:44 ends mercy's extension at a time, and 36:48 asks when the promise is.
After the two cries, 36:53 places everyone present before the deictic identification in 36:63.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured stages, bounded respite, an explicit timing challenge, and final presence; I join them into one appointment arc. Alternatively, cosmic measurement may remain an analogy rather than part of the judgment timetable.

changed_reading.after: The recipients have arrived at the measured rendezvous, and هَٰذِهِ announces that the appointment is now spatially present.

context_deltas.mechanism: The promise is first made a truth-test, then the awakened speakers themselves identify it as the Merciful's promise and acknowledge the messengers; the focus address becomes official ratification of a recognition forced by events.

activation_trace.role: A spoken promise that opens expectation anchors the repeated promise-language whose credibility is contested and then conceded.
The named promise becomes the object of the opponents' demand for fulfillment.
Truth of speech makes the timing challenge a test of whether the warning can be trusted.
The same promise is now identified by the awakened recipients rather than challenged by them.
Mercy and tenderness identify the promiser and prevent the fulfilled threat from being detached from the surah's mercy frame.
Truth of speech reverses the earlier challenge into acknowledgment.
Messenger and message identify the human transmission channel whose credibility is finally conceded.

structural_cues: 36:48 asks when 'this promise' will come if the speakers are truthful.
36:52 answers with 'this is what the Merciful promised,' and 36:63 repeats the deictic-plus-promise frame in an authoritative address.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical and deictic repetition across challenge, recognition, and address; I infer that 36:63 officially seals the recipients' own recognition. The alternative is three independent restatements with no dialogical ratification.

changed_reading.before: The authority tells the condemned which punishment this is.
changed_reading.after: The authority seals as verdict the promise they first mocked and then found themselves compelled to recognize.

context_deltas.mechanism: Act-matched judgment separates the criminal cohort, recalls its covenant and rejected path, and then moves directly from pointing out Jahannam to commanding contact with its fire; the focus utterance functions as destination allocation.

activation_trace.role: The appointed-place branch lets the deictic utterance assign the separated cohort to its destination.
Recompense corresponding to action establishes the adjudicative frame for the later allocation.
Separation by clear differentiation produces the cohort directly addressed by the focus.
A preserved covenant supplies the prior obligation reviewed before destination is assigned.
The straight road supplies the offered route against which the destination is spatially contrasted.
Departure from guidance explains why the cohort arrives at the contrary destination.
Meeting the fire and its heat turns the focus identification into the threshold of actual entry.

structural_cues: 36:55-58 describe the garden cohort before 36:59 orders the criminal cohort to separate.
36:60-62 review covenant, path, and misguidance; 36:63 points out the destination; 36:64 commands fire-contact today because of disbelief.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ordered adjudication, separation, review, identification, and entry sequence; I infer that the deictic utterance itself performs allocation. A live alternative is that it only describes the object before a separately operative imperative.

changed_reading.after: This sentence assigns a separated cohort to its appointed destination at the threshold of entry.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated ك و ن clauses bind the truth challenge, prior deeds, failed reasoning, disbelief, and earning into a grammatical dossier; كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ is one link in a history of what the addressees persistently were.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence and presence in time anchor the focus's 'you were being promised' clause within the repeated temporal pattern.
The prior state 'if you were truthful' opens the recurring كُنتُمْ dossier with a credibility challenge.
The temporal occurrence of what they were doing joins conduct to the judgment record.
The prior state of failing to reason adds rejected understanding to the dossier immediately before the focus.
The state of persistent disbelief supplies the adjacent ground for entering the identified destination.
The temporal record of what they were earning closes the sequence with embodied testimony.

structural_cues: The repeated frames are 'if you were truthful' (36:48), 'what you were doing' (36:54), 'were you not reasoning' (36:62), 'you were promised' (36:63), 'you were disbelieving' (36:64), and 'what they were earning' (36:65).
The focus clause sits at the center of three adjacent ك و ن clauses in 36:62-65.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated root and parallel second-person histories; I treat the recurrence as a dossier that binds promise to conduct and response. The live alternative is that ك و ن is merely a common auxiliary with no cross-verse compositional force.

changed_reading.before: You had repeatedly been promised this.
changed_reading.after: Your being promised this is presented inside a retained history of what you did, failed to understand, denied, and earned.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ending restates warning as the point where a saying becomes true, then joins command, saying, and occurrence in كُن فَيَكُونُ; this activates the focus as promised speech backed by the capacity to instantiate its object.

activation_trace.role: The promise as committed speech anchors the model of fulfillment through efficacious saying.
Occurrence in time links the recipients' prior promised state to the later command-to-being formula.
Warning that awakens caution restates the communicative act whose adverse realization the focus displays.
A saying fixed in correspondence with reality supplies the explicit warning-to-fulfillment hinge.
Spoken utterance supplies what becomes real against the deniers.
Command as an obligatory request supplies the initiating force in the final creation formula.
The act of saying directly mediates between will and occurrence.
Occurrence and coming-to-presence complete the command-to-being pattern and illuminate how a promised object can be made present.

structural_cues: 36:70 places warning beside the saying becoming true against deniers.
36:82 compresses willing, commanding speech, and occurrence into one sequence after the resurrection arguments.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies both warning-to-true-saying and command-to-occurrence sequences; I infer that the same speech efficacy underwrites the focus promise. The alternative is that 36:82 concerns creation alone and should not govern the rhetoric of punishment.

changed_reading.before: The threat accurately forecasts a later object.
changed_reading.after: The promised object is now present because the warning belongs to speech capable of becoming what it says.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because passive تُوعَدُونَ most naturally denotes verbal promising or threatening, not an omen. It remains anchored because the focus inventory explicitly includes a sign that promises a future state, while the surah repeatedly labels disclosures as signs and later shows fire emerging from green material. Downstream prose should mark this as a sign-analogy, not replace the direct threat sense with it.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The B006 branch of focus-root و ع د lets هَٰذِهِ name the disclosed state toward which earlier signs had been pointing.

activation_trace.role: A promising indicator from which a future condition is anticipated recasts the focus promise as a predictive sign.
A manifest sign supplies the repeated surah-level form by which a hidden future capacity becomes legible.
A second manifest sign makes predictive disclosure a sequence rather than an isolated image.
Kindled fire supplies the latent adverse state disclosed from apparently contrary green matter.
Ignition turns latent fire into an enacted material analogy for هَٰذِهِ.

changed_reading.before: The verse identifies the object of an earlier verbal threat.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the verse unveils the adverse state that the surah's signs had materially foreshadowed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because the focus passive is not the reciprocal form expected for mutual promising. It remains worth carrying because the focus inventory preserves a mutual-promise branch and the immediately preceding address reviews a covenant, severing allegiance, enmity, and an offered road. Downstream prose should call it an exploratory relational overlay, never the primary grammar of تُوعَدُونَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The B004 branch of focus-root و ع د overlays the promised destination with the relational failure reviewed in 36:60-61.

activation_trace.role: Mutual promising supplies the exploratory relational frame within which the adverse appointment follows a failed compact.
A preserved covenant supplies the prior relational commitment being reviewed.
Distance and severing supply the breach-like movement away from the covenanting relation.
Enmity supplies the rival allegiance that makes the resulting appointment adverse.
The straight road supplies the relationally offered route whose rejection ends at the contrary rendezvous.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the adverse appointment also marks the terminal relational consequence of a rejected covenant and path.

strongest_changes: The remote warning became a deictically present reality and an officially ratified acknowledgment after the promise was challenged.
Appointment, preparation, counting, record, and recompense made Jahannam a timed and readied destination rather than an arbitrary surprise.
The separation-covenant-path-entry sequence made 36:63 function as cohort allocation at the threshold of fire-contact.
Repeated ك و ن clauses bound the promise to the addressees' retained history, while the closing كُن فَيَكُونُ pattern made fulfillment look speech-effective.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context exposed the exact promise repetitions at 36:48 and 36:52, the dense ك و ن chain around 36:63, and the immediate adjudicative sequence. The split و ع د mappings also kept counted preparation and predictive-sign readings visible without displacing the direct threat.
remaining_uncertainties: Measured cosmic timing may be only an analogy for the judgment appointment rather than part of one timetable.
The ع د د preparation and duration activation is packet-grounded but form-distant from the direct و ع د sense.
The deictic sentence may merely identify Jahannam before 36:64 rather than itself perform allocation.
The reciprocal-promise overlay remains highly exploratory because the focus morphology is passive, not reciprocal.
